description:
Cast Sunshower Druid by paying {G}.
When Sunshower Druid enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Sunshower Druid
When Sunshower Druid dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Sunshower Druid from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
